lines.zh: 我走不了，茧是粘在叶子上的。
lines.en: I can't walk; this cocoon is glued to the leaf.

lines.zh: 要是能动，我想爬到更高的枝上。
lines.en: If I could move, I'd climb to a higher branch.

lines.zh: 里面很挤，伸手伸脚都得等。
lines.en: It's cramped in here; every limb must wait.

lines.zh: 风一来，整片叶子带着我晃。
lines.en: When the wind comes, the leaf sways me with it.

lines.zh: 我被树叶的脉托着，走不了半步。
lines.en: A leaf vein holds me; I can't take a step.

lines.zh: 每过一天，我就在里面变一点。
lines.en: Each day I change a little inside.

lines.zh: 我听见村子里的鸡叫，很近。
lines.en: I hear village chickens, quite near.

lines.zh: 旁边有虫在咬叶子，我动不了。
lines.en: A bug is chewing the leaf beside me. I can't move.

lines.zh: 我的壳从里面往外顶，胀。
lines.en: I press outward from inside. It's tight.

lines.zh: 我等着，这是我唯一能做的。
lines.en: I wait. That's all I can do.

lines.zh: 雨打在我的茧上，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: Rain hits my cocoon with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 叶子一沉，我就知道有东西落下。
lines.en: When the leaf dips, I know something has landed.

lines.zh: 叶柄摇得厉害，我抓紧内壁。
lines.en: The stem shakes hard; I grip the inner wall.

lines.zh: 我从这头挪到那头，用了一整天。
lines.en: Moving from one end to the other took me a day.

lines.zh: 再忍忍，翅膀在里面挤着。
lines.en: A bit longer. My wings are folded tight in here.

lines.zh: 我挂在这片叶子下面，看不见天。
lines.en: I hang beneath this leaf and can't see the sky.

lines.zh: 挂在叶背，我只等羽化。
lines.en: Hanging beneath the leaf, I wait to emerge.

lines.zh: 茧上有一层薄薄的丝，反着光。
lines.en: A thin silk layer shines on the cocoon.

lines.zh: 里面的我，抱成一团。
lines.en: Inside, I'm curled into a ball.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到叶子的脉搏。
lines.en: I can feel the leaf's slow pulse.

lines.zh: 外面有蝴蝶飞过，翅膀响。
lines.en: A butterfly passes outside; I hear the wings.

lines.zh: 我数着光暗的次数。
lines.en: I count how many times the light goes and comes.

lines.zh: 我极安静，连呼吸都很轻。
lines.en: I'm very still. Even my breathing is faint.

lines.zh: 这层壳慢慢变硬了。
lines.en: This shell is hardening by degrees.

lines.zh: 我贴在叶脉交汇处，那儿结实。
lines.en: I sit where the veins meet. It's sturdy there.

lines.zh: 村里的烟从下面飘上来。
lines.en: Village smoke drifts up from below.

lines.zh: 丝又绕了一层，我缩进去。
lines.en: Another layer of silk; I settle deeper in.

lines.zh: 有蚂蚁在茧外面绕。
lines.en: Ants are circling outside the cocoon.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你，只是我出不来。
lines.en: You look at me and I at you, only I can't get out.

lines.zh: 别碰我，茧会破的。
lines.en: Don't touch me. The cocoon would tear.

lines.zh: 我的影子挂在叶子背面，很淡。
lines.en: My shadow hangs under the leaf, faint.

lines.zh: 你凑得这么近，能听见我动吗？
lines.en: So close — can you hear me stirring?

lines.zh: 这片叶子就是我的屋子。
lines.en: This leaf is my house.

lines.zh: 你要是搬走我，我就没法羽化了。
lines.en: If you move me, I can't finish changing.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚步声，重。
lines.en: I know your tread. Heavy.

lines.zh: 白天我藏在叶下，你偏要找我。
lines.en: By day I hide under a leaf, and you insist on finding me.

lines.zh: 我还没成形，别急着看。
lines.en: I'm not finished forming. Don't be in a hurry.

lines.zh: 你把手放下，我就安心了。
lines.en: Put your hand down and I'll settle.

lines.zh: 茧上凹了一小块。
lines.en: A dent in the cocoon.

lines.zh: 我在里面晃得发晕。
lines.en: The shaking leaves me dizzy.

lines.zh: 丝断了几根。
lines.en: A few threads have snapped.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，尽量不动。
lines.en: I curl tight and try not to move.

lines.zh: 壳透气的地方破了一点。
lines.en: A small hole in the shell's air passage.

lines.zh: 疼是隔着一层传来的。
lines.en: The pain comes through a layer.

lines.zh: 我还没成形，经不起。
lines.en: I'm not formed yet. I can't take this.

lines.zh: 叶子又晃，我抓紧内壁。
lines.en: The leaf sways again; I grip the wall.

lines.zh: 我努力把壳补上一层。
lines.en: I try to add another layer of silk.

lines.zh: 再打，我就出不来这个形状了。
lines.en: Hit me again and I'll never come out right.

lines.zh: 你手里有叶子吗？
lines.en: Do you have a leaf in your hand?

lines.zh: 这片叶子的边缘被啃过了。
lines.en: The edge of this leaf has been nibbled.

lines.zh: 如果有新叶，我会想挪过去。
lines.en: If there were a fresh leaf, I'd want to move.

lines.zh: 我做不了什么，只能看着。
lines.en: I can't do anything but look.

lines.zh: 你的手停在叶子旁边了。
lines.en: Your hand has stopped beside the leaf.

lines.zh: 别把叶子晃得太厉害。
lines.en: Don't shake the leaf too hard.

lines.zh: 我听见蚕食的声音。
lines.en: I hear chewing.

lines.zh: 那颜色是新鲜的绿。
lines.en: That color is fresh green.

lines.zh: 我这里已经够挤了。
lines.en: It's crowded enough in here.

lines.zh: 等你走了，我继续等。
lines.en: Once you go, I'll go back to waiting.

lines.zh: 你碰了叶子，我跟着一荡。
lines.en: You touched the leaf and I swung with it.

lines.zh: 这层茧比看上去结实。
lines.en: This cocoon is tougher than it looks.

lines.zh: 别捏，我在里面。
lines.en: Don't squeeze. I'm inside.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀蹭到叶柄了。
lines.en: Your shoulder brushed the leaf stem.

lines.zh: 我贴着内壁，稳住自己。
lines.en: I press to the inner wall and steady myself.

lines.zh: 叶子一斜，我滑了一下。
lines.en: The leaf tilted and I slipped.

lines.zh: 这一撞，茧上多了道折痕。
lines.en: That left a crease in the cocoon.

lines.zh: 你退开，叶子还在晃。
lines.en: You've stepped back, but the leaf still sways.

lines.zh: 我从这里掉下去就完了。
lines.en: If I fall from here, it's over.

lines.zh: 小心点，我落不到地上。
lines.en: Easy. I couldn't survive the ground.

lines.zh: 我连自己在变成什么都还不知道。
lines.en: I don't even know what I'm becoming yet.

lines.zh: 等我出来，才有别的事。
lines.en: Once I'm out, there will be other matters.

lines.zh: 我困在这层壳里，什么也做不成。
lines.en: Trapped in this shell, I can do nothing.

lines.zh: 我这一片叶子上，只有我自己。
lines.en: On this leaf, there's only me.

lines.zh: 外面的同伴在飞，我听着。
lines.en: The others are flying outside. I listen.

lines.zh: 我心里只有一件事，就是出去。
lines.en: I have one thought: getting out.

lines.zh: 你等不了那么久的。
lines.en: You can't wait that long.

lines.zh: 我出来的时候，会记得这阵风。
lines.en: When I come out, I'll remember this wind.

lines.zh: 也许有一天，我会认得你的声音。
lines.en: Perhaps one day I'll know your voice.

lines.zh: 现在，我只想安静。
lines.en: For now, I only want quiet.

lines.zh: 叶子落下来，我跟着下去了。
lines.en: The leaf fell, and I went with it.

lines.zh: 我用不上那些东西。
lines.en: I've no use for those.

lines.zh: 茧里缩着，动一动都难。
lines.en: Curled in a cocoon, even stirring is hard.

lines.zh: 要是有东西落在我旁边，我只能等。
lines.en: If something falls beside me, I can only wait.

lines.zh: 茧壳外面有点黏，会粘住碎叶。
lines.en: The cocoon's sticky outside; bits of leaf stick to it.

lines.zh: 一片碎叶贴在我身上，遮了点光。
lines.en: A leaf fragment clings to me and blocks some light.

lines.zh: 那点重量，我不在乎。
lines.en: That little weight doesn't bother me.

lines.zh: 等我的翅膀出来，就能飞过去。
lines.en: When my wings are out, I'll fly over.

lines.zh: 现在，我只能靠着叶子。
lines.en: For now I can only lean on the leaf.

lines.zh: 你别替我收，我自己用不上。
lines.en: Don't gather it for me. I can't use it.

lines.zh: 叶子上有影子，晃了一下。
lines.en: A shadow moved across the leaf.

lines.zh: 有东西在叶面上走。
lines.en: Something's walking on the leaf surface.

lines.zh: 我听见咀嚼声，离得很近。
lines.en: I hear chewing, very near.

lines.zh: 茧晃时，我贴住内壁不动。
lines.en: When the cocoon sways, I press to its wall.

lines.zh: 那是鸟的爪子吗？我不确定。
lines.en: Are those bird claws? I can't tell.

lines.zh: 我一动，茧就晃，反而明显。
lines.en: If I move, the cocoon shakes and gives me away.

lines.zh: 我等着它过去。
lines.en: I'm waiting for it to pass.

lines.zh: 这片叶子的位置，我改不了。
lines.en: I can't change where this leaf is.

lines.zh: 影子停了，就在我上面。
lines.en: The shadow stopped, right above me.

lines.zh: 我只能希望它不吃茧。
lines.en: I can only hope it doesn't eat cocoons.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，装成一片枯叶。
lines.en: I hold still and pretend to be a dead leaf.

lines.zh: 我的茧颜色跟树皮差不多。
lines.en: My cocoon is much the same color as the bark.

lines.zh: 那东西又绕回来了。
lines.en: That thing has come around again.

lines.zh: 我屏住，等它走远。
lines.en: I hold everything still until it's gone.

lines.zh: 叶子被压得往下弯。
lines.en: The leaf is bending under weight.

lines.zh: 我听见它在叶脉上停住。
lines.en: I hear it stop on the vein.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩到最里面。
lines.en: I pull myself as deep inside as I can.

lines.zh: 这一层壳，是我仅有的东西。
lines.en: This shell is all I have.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，就安全了。
lines.en: A little longer and I'll be safe.

lines.zh: 它走了，叶子还在轻轻颤。
lines.en: It's gone, but the leaf still trembles.

lines.zh: 我什么都做不了，只能硬着。
lines.en: There's nothing I can do but be hard.

lines.zh: 这层茧是我唯一的挡头。
lines.en: This cocoon is my only shield.

lines.zh: 你敲一下，我就往里缩。
lines.en: You tap it and I draw in further.

lines.zh: 我连翅膀都还没张开。
lines.en: I haven't even opened my wings.

lines.zh: 壳很硬，你的牙会疼。
lines.en: The shell's hard. Your teeth would ache.

lines.zh: 我不还手，我也不会。
lines.en: I don't fight back. I can't.

lines.zh: 你要是咬开我，里面全是黏液。
lines.en: Bite me open and it's all fluid inside.

lines.zh: 我只能等这一下过去。
lines.en: I can only wait for this to pass.

lines.zh: 这一层丝挡了一下。
lines.en: The silk layer stopped it, partly.

lines.zh: 别把我捏碎，还没到时候。
lines.en: Don't crush me. It isn't time yet.

lines.zh: 我在叶子上结成了这个茧。
lines.en: I made this cocoon on the leaf.

lines.zh: 最后一段丝拉完，我就封住了。
lines.en: The last thread drawn, and I sealed myself in.

lines.zh: 叶脉正好托住我，不晃。
lines.en: A leaf vein holds me steady.

lines.zh: 从里面看，叶子是半透明的。
lines.en: From in here the leaf is translucent.

lines.zh: 这是我的第二个样子。
lines.en: This is my second shape.

lines.zh: 村子就下面那片屋顶。
lines.en: The village is those roofs below.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶背面，谁也看不见。
lines.en: I hang under the leaf where no one looks.

lines.zh: 第一天，我什么都不做。
lines.en: Day one, I do nothing at all.

lines.zh: 丝粘住叶子，很牢。
lines.en: The silk holds tight to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我开始变，慢慢地变。
lines.en: I begin to change. Slowly.

lines.zh: 丝一遇火就卷，很危险。
lines.en: Silk curls at fire. Very dangerous.

lines.zh: 叶子掉了，我一起摔下去。
lines.en: The leaf fell and I fell with it.

lines.zh: 水渗进来，我在里面憋着。
lines.en: Water seeps in and I'm holding my breath.

lines.zh: 冲击把叶子撕开了。
lines.en: The blast tears the leaf apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过叶片，钉在我旁边。
lines.en: The arrow pierces the leaf and pins beside me.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的壳发紧。
lines.en: That force pulls my shell tight.

lines.zh: 我在里面不吃不喝，只能撑。
lines.en: No food or water in here; I can only last.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，整片叶子都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the whole leaf lights up.

lines.zh: 这里没有叶子，我的丝没处挂。
lines.en: No leaf here; my silk has nothing to hold.
